subcases.title: Happy path: 完整 shared identity + DB write 成功
subcases.preconditions: 临时 worktree config + 独立 DB + 真实 Skill 文件 + FRAMEWORK_SKILL_READ_HARD_GATE=1
subcases.oracle: ORA-PT-11: 共享 identity (sessionID/agent/scope/callerLabel) 完整 → verified:true

subcases.title: Empty required list: required=[] → deny
subcases.preconditions: 正常 session + DB；attest.required 列表显式置空
subcases.inject: 在 attestSkillRead() 调用前把 required 改 []
subcases.oracle: ORA-PT-13: required list 非空校验未通过 → verified:false, state_written:false

subcases.title: Missing identity: session/agent/scope 任一缺失 → deny
subcases.preconditions: 正常 session + DB；分别删 sessionID / agent / canonicalTaskScope
subcases.inject: 分三轮,每轮缺一个 identity 字段,跑 attestSkillRead()
subcases.oracle: ORA-PT-13: canonical identity 校验失败 → verified:false, state_written:false, 旧状态失效

subcases.title: Child hint mismatch: root session 标识 vs child session 标识不一致 → deny
subcases.preconditions: 父 session 创建 child session,parentSessionID 不匹配 childSessionID 上报的 hint
subcases.inject: 在 dispatch_subagent 生成的 child session 上,篡改 childSessionHint.parentSessionID
subcases.oracle: ORA-PT-11: identity 一致性校验失败 → verified:false, state_written:false

subcases.title: DB write 失败: state_written=false → deny + 旧状态失效
subcases.preconditions: DB 写故障注入 (DB write throws / connection drop) + 之前存在有效 old state
subcases.inject: 在 dbWriteSubState() 注入 throw,验证 fail-closed 行为
subcases.oracle: ORA-PT-11/13: 原子写失败 → verified:false, 旧 row 标记失效 (fail-closed)

subcases.title: Stale state: 之前写过的 old state 在新一次写失败后不可用
subcases.preconditions: 先成功 attest 一次 (建立有效 old state) → 第二次注入 DB write fail
subcases.inject: 先 happy path 写一次,再触发 SC-T039-05 故障,验证后续 attest 全部 false
subcases.oracle: ORA-PT-13: 写失败后旧有效 state 不可用, 后续请求 fail-closed
